02

Getting here & parking

Deeper Life Bible Church 1368 W Main St Lewisville, TX 75067

Free parking is available in the lot around the plaza where the church meets. Look for the large Deeper Life Lewisville sign in front of the building — it shows you’re in the right place.

Get directions
03

Your Sunday, step by step

Our Sunday service lasts about two and a half hours and blends singing, prayer, Bible study and teaching.

  1. 9:00 AM · Pray with us online

    Before the service, we pray together on Zoom. You’re welcome to join from wherever you are.

  2. 9:30 AM · Worship begins

    Singing and prayer as we come together in God’s presence.

  3. 9:40 AM · Search The Scriptures

    Our Sunday Bible class, with separate classes for children, youth and adults.

  4. Teaching from God’s Word

    The service continues with worship and teaching, closing at 12:00 PM.

  5. After the service

    We’ll welcome you as our guest and give you a church card. Our ushers will walk you through the next steps.

04

For the whole family

Kids & families

Children of every age are welcome in worship. During the Sunday service, we also offer a safe, staffed Children’s Church for infants through 6th grade.

What to wear

Come as you are. You’ll see everything from Sunday best to comfortable clothes. We care far more about you being here than what you’re wearing.
